mission.title: Stakeout
mission.description: Guard a hardline junction box against saboteurs.

phase.briefing: Although we are currently upgrading the security code protecting hardlines throughout the City, until this new code comes online the hardlines will remain vulnerable to sabotage. You will patrol the vicinity of a hardline junction box and watch for suspicious activity. Eradicate anyone attempting to tamper with the box.

enter.say: The junction box is in that building. You will locate the box and patrol the vicinity until our new junction box security program is online. If any intruders threaten the box, you are to destroy them immediately.

done.say: There's the junction box. Now look-- Wait. I'm detecting Exile programs in your immediate vicinity. Better take them out.
Our upgraded junction box security is now online. You may leave the area, {player}.

mission.finish: You handled those multiple attackers well, operative--we are impressed. The hardlines in this sector are now secure, but we may have a use for your battle prowess elsewhere.
